paragraphs: Make a 4th spec for your class: 1 active skill and 1 passive skill. Then give each skill 2 orb mods, each with 1 to 3 levels.
Don't worry about mana costs or damage/healing numbers, we'll tweak those later.
It should still feel like the class, but be something new that plays differently from the other 3 specs. Check out the class's 4 base skills first, since your spec builds off of those.
When you're done, push your changes to the repo and I'll take care of getting it built and tested in game.
title: Your job: make the 4th spec
